signatures.provenance: Owner-proposed MVP scenario; not an empirically established attack pattern.
requiredEvidence: Versioned upstream definition of flood, detector configuration and supporting evidence.
Independent support for the drone observation; a generic radio hit is insufficient.
An explicit shared clock mapping and uncertainty before comparing producer timestamps.
Preserved source/session identities, slice references and loss/coverage reports.
lookalikes: Unrelated radio interference followed by an unrelated aircraft observation.
Legitimate nearby activity coinciding in time.
qualificationRequired: Positive sequences, partial sequences, reverse order, outside interval and benign lookalikes.
Missed events, false warnings and warning lead time on held-out recordings.
Offline operation and restart/replay behavior on supported phones.
limits: 90 seconds is a scenario parameter, not an established attack timing law.
30 seconds is a development analysis goal, not a proven response time or universal deadline.
The matcher reports temporal association, not causality or attack confirmation.
